Build a PTI

This page is a placeholder. A step-by-step guide to building and deploying a Project Targeting Index (PTI) application will be added here.

Overview

Building a PTI application with devPTIpack involves three high-level steps:

  1. Prepare your data — shapes (administrative boundaries) and a metadata Excel template describing your indicators.
  2. Validate your inputs — run the built-in validators to catch problems before deployment.
  3. Launch the app — use launch_pti() or launch_pti_onepage() to start an interactive Shiny dashboard.

Step 1 — Scaffold a new project

Use create_new_pti() to copy the bundled template into a new directory:

library(devPTIpack)
create_new_pti("path/to/my_pti_project")
